reason: Slurm binary not found: scontrol. Is Slurm installed? slurmwatch reads Slurm's own tools (scontrol, squeue, sstat), so they have to be on PATH. If Slurm IS installed here, its bin directory isn't in this shell's PATH (try `module load slurm`); if this cluster runs PBS, Flux or Kubernetes instead, slurmwatch cannot monitor it. Retrying will not help.
